Hi Elena,

Quick note ahead of next week's renewal — thanks for the usage data you shared last month. We ran a short health recap for Attain and wanted to share the highlights and a few pragmatic options to stabilize unit economics while preserving performance: 

- Observed: token consumption +35% QoQ driven by higher embedding/semantic search fanout; generation RT tokens fairly steady.
- Perf: 95th latency steady at ~160ms for typical web flows; tail spikes tied to very long context evaluation (we call out a few 20k token jobs in Q1 report).
- Econ: baseline per-token spend increased ~18% on your current mix; our ROI model (attached) shows a 6–9% margin compression if you stay at current throughput and pricing.

Attachments: Q1-usage-report.pdf (summary), ROI-Delta.xlsx (token-mix sensitivity).

Options we typically propose (short bullets so we can align in a call):
1) Term realignment — 12-month commit at +25% tokens (lower unit price) with quarterly checkpoints.
2) Dedicated pilot — 90-day reserved pool (trial) to validate latency tail improvements and KV-cache effectiveness before committing.
3) Hybrid — 6-month bridge commit + 3-month dedicated burst allowance during peak windows.

Can we grab 30 minutes next week to walk through the numbers and pick a path? I can also draft a short mutual action plan after we pick an option.

Best,
